name: [Part 1] historical edge state survives later mutations
input: follow, snapshot, unfollow, snapshot, and refollow
test:
graph = VersionedSocialGraph()
assert graph.snapshot() == 0
assert graph.follow('alice', 'bob')
followed = graph.snapshot()
assert followed == 1
assert graph.is_following('alice', 'bob', followed)
assert not graph.follow('alice', 'bob')
assert graph.snapshot() == followed
assert graph.unfollow('alice', 'bob')
unfollowed = graph.snapshot()
assert not graph.is_following('alice', 'bob', unfollowed)
assert graph.is_following('alice', 'bob', followed)
assert not graph.unfollow('alice', 'bob')
assert graph.follow('alice', 'bob')
assert graph.is_following('alice', 'bob')

name: [Part 1] invalid users and snapshots are rejected
input: self-follow, non-string user, negative version, and future version

name: [Part 2] incoming and outgoing lists are versioned
input: two snapshots around an unfollow and a new follower
test:
graph = VersionedSocialGraph()
graph.follow('alice', 'bob')
graph.follow('alice', 'carol')
graph.follow('dave', 'bob')
first = graph.snapshot()
graph.unfollow('alice', 'bob')
graph.follow('erin', 'bob')
second = graph.snapshot()
assert graph.get_followees('alice', first) == ['bob', 'carol']
assert graph.get_followers('bob', first) == ['alice', 'dave']
assert graph.get_followees('alice', second) == ['carol']
assert graph.get_followers('bob', second) == ['dave', 'erin']
assert graph.get_followers('missing') == []

name: [Part 3] recommendations score mutual followees and break ties
input: three direct followees with overlapping second-hop candidates
test:
graph = VersionedSocialGraph()
for direct in ('bob', 'carol', 'dave'):
    graph.follow('alice', direct)
for edge in [
    ('bob', 'zoe'), ('carol', 'zoe'),
    ('bob', 'erin'), ('dave', 'erin'),
    ('carol', 'frank'),
    ('bob', 'alice'),
    ('dave', 'carol'),
]:
    graph.follow(*edge)
assert graph.recommend('alice', 10) == [('erin', 2), ('zoe', 2), ('frank', 1)]
assert graph.recommend('alice', 2) == [('erin', 2), ('zoe', 2)]
assert graph.recommend('alice', 0) == []

name: [Part 3] recommendations honor historical snapshots
input: candidate added after the first snapshot and removed after the second
test:
graph = VersionedSocialGraph()
graph.follow('a', 'b')
graph.follow('a', 'c')
graph.follow('b', 'x')
first = graph.snapshot()
graph.follow('c', 'x')
graph.follow('b', 'y')
second = graph.snapshot()
graph.unfollow('b', 'x')
assert graph.recommend('a', 5, first) == [('x', 1)]
assert graph.recommend('a', 5, second) == [('x', 2), ('y', 1)]
assert graph.recommend('a', 5) == [('x', 1), ('y', 1)]
for bad_k in (-1, 1.5, True):
    try:
        graph.recommend('a', bad_k)
        assert False, 'expected ValueError'
    except ValueError:
        pass
